title: Wiemer scroll reveal (v2)
description: CSS-only scroll-driven reveals in Wiemer's calm manner: a plain fade, a short 25px rise with a fade, and a parallax drift for pictures inside their frames. Staggers by starting each item a little later in the scroll.
notes: uses animation-timeline: view(); browsers without it, and reduced motion, show everything in place
use the wrapper, or put wiemerV2Reveal(effect) and wiemerV2RevealStyle(step) on your own element
crop drifting pictures with overflow-clip, not overflow-hidden
